canonical_statement: Let X be a compact Kahler manifold of complex dimension n and E a Nakano-positive holomorphic vector bundle on X. Then H^q(X, Omega^p_X tensor E) vanishes whenever p + q > n.
domain_and_universes: NakanoVanishingData.{uX,uE,uH} has a manifold carrier X : Type uX, a bundle-total-space carrier E : Type uE, complexDimension : Nat, and coefficient cohomology types Cohomology p q : Type uH with AddCommGroup instances; p q : Nat; the target is Prop.
hypotheses: X is a compact Kahler manifold
E is a holomorphic vector bundle on X
p + q is strictly greater than the complex dimension
conclusion: Subsingleton (D.Cohomology p q), the type-level zero-group form of H^q(X, Omega^p_X tensor E) = 0.
